notes.title: Welcome to Boom Squad
notes.content:
Howdy folks and welcome to the Boom Squad group.

We're going to release Boom Squad on Steam Early Access in April. Meanwhile you can help us with the finishing touches by playing the game and giving us feedback.

Join our Discord to play the game now: https://discord.me/playboomsquad
